# lifecycle-sync

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-001 — The extension activates only on its own entry points](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-001.md) — When VS Code loads the extension manifest, the extension SHALL declare VS Code 1.95 as its lowest supported version and as its only activation events the two Studio commands, the Studio Open With editor and the Studio preview panel serializer, and contribute no command whose identifier starts with markdown. and no language and no grammar, so that the built-in Markdown support is neither activated nor replaced.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-003 — Open Preview to Side opens or reveals a side preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-003.md) — When a reader runs Open Preview to Side on a saved Markdown file, the extension SHALL show that file in the side preview that follows the active editor, by creating that preview beside the active editor when none is open and otherwise revealing it, and offer the command only for a resource whose extension is .md.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-010 — Open Preview to Side checks the file it is given](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-010.md) — When Open Preview to Side runs, the extension SHALL preview only a saved file with the extension .md, taken from the active editor (a text editor, or the Studio Open With tab) or from a file URI the command receives, ignore an argument that is not a URI of the file scheme, and otherwise show the message Open a Markdown file to use Markdown OKF-Schema Studio. or the error Cannot open {path}: {reason} and open no preview.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-018 — The Open With editor shows its own Markdown file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-018.md) — When a reader opens a .md file with the optional Markdown OKF-Schema Studio editor through Open With, the extension SHALL resolve the editor at once and show that file in a tab that keeps showing it whatever editor becomes active, leave the other previews open, and show a page that names the refusal or the failure when the document is not a saved .md file or the preview cannot be created.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-024 — The panel title names the document and whether it follows](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-024.md) — When a preview panel is created, restored, switched to another document or finishes a render, the extension SHALL title the side preview Studio · {file name}, a fixed preview with the bare file name, and a panel with no known document Studio, using the title of the document the panel shows.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-026 — The side preview follows the active Markdown editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-026.md) — When another saved Markdown file becomes the active editor, the extension SHALL switch only the newest side preview that follows the editor to that file, show Preview pending with the message Following the active Markdown editor. until its render ends, apply only the last requested document when the editor changes during the switch, and leave the preview unchanged for any other editor change.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-032 — Refresh Preview renders the shown document again](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-032.md) — When a reader runs Refresh Preview, by the command or by the Refresh button, the extension SHALL render the document of the newest live preview again from its buffer, unsaved text included, doing nothing when the active text editor shows another document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-038 — Each preview has its own state and only the newest follows](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-038.md) — When several previews are open, the extension SHALL give each its own session with its own document, render queue, file watchers and reading state, and, when VS Code restores several panels, let only the newest follow the active editor, the older ones becoming fixed previews titled with the bare file name.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-039 — Typing renders the new text after a short pause, without writing files](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-039.md) — When the text of a document changes, saved or not, the extension SHALL queue a render of the new text in every preview that shows that document, start it 40 ms after the last change and let a running render finish first, without writing to the shown file or to any build output folder of the workspace; a preview whose panel is hidden SHALL not render until the panel is shown, and previews of the same document, revision and render options SHALL share one render.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-044 — Changes to files and settings the render depends on render again](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-044.md) — When a file that the shown render depends on is changed, created, deleted or renamed below the preview's root, or a markdownOkfSchemaStudio preview, plantuml or frontmatter setting changes, the extension SHALL render the shown document again or bring the page up to date, ignoring file events below build and tool folders of that root.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-048 — A changed setting that the page reads only at startup loads a new page document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-048.md) — When scrollPreviewWithEditor, scrollEditorWithPreview, markEditorSelection or stickyHeadingDepth changes, the extension SHALL load a new page document instead of patching the loaded one.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-049 — The status names the render state and shows pending, failed and recovered notices](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-049.md) — When the preview shows a render state, the extension SHALL label the status Preview pending, Preview ready, Preview is stale, Preview unavailable, Preview source missing or Preview recovered, show a pending notice for a slow render and leave a page that is already shown unchanged while a render is pending.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-055 — The page ignores a pending notice with an oversized or malformed field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-055.md) — When the page receives a pending notice whose visible field is not a boolean or whose label or message is longer than 500 characters, the extension SHALL ignore it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-059 — The status region is a polite live region of plain text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-059.md) — When the extension writes a status, it SHALL write an aside with role status and aria-live polite that holds the label in bold, the message in its own element and the diagnostics as a list, with every text as plain text and never as markup.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-062 — A preview without a source says why and recovers when it returns](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-062.md) — When the source of a preview is not an existing Markdown file inside its root, the extension SHALL replace the page by the status Preview source missing with the reason of the case, and render the source again when its file is created.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-069 — A render of the loaded document updates the page in place](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-069.md) — When a render finishes and the loaded page can take its content, the extension SHALL send only the new content of the page as a content patch, which the page applies in place and reports ready, instead of a new page document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-071 — A render that cannot patch loads a new page document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-071.md) — When a render changes the page shell, for example a diagram engine or math appears or disappears, or cannot otherwise be applied to the loaded page as a content patch, the extension SHALL load a new page document instead of a content patch.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-074 — The page refuses a patch whose status lines break the same bounds](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-074.md) — When the page receives a content patch with a malformed status line or with more than 500 lines, a text over 20000 characters or a severity over 50 characters, the extension SHALL ignore the whole patch.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-081 — After a patch the page answers only to the new identifiers](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-081.md) — When a content patch has moved the page to the next render, the page SHALL refuse host messages that name the previous render.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-082 — A patch with stale or malformed fields is ignored](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-082.md) — When a content patch names the wrong current identifiers or carries malformed fields, the page SHALL ignore it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-089 — Equal blocks pair in document order and each kept node is used once](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-089.md) — When two blocks of a patch have the same HTML, the page SHALL pair them with the old equal blocks in document order and use each kept node once.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-090 — Nodes the page added itself are never kept](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-090.md) — When the page replaces its content with a patch, it SHALL NOT keep text nodes or nodes that the page added itself and that have no recorded key.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-091 — A block with a link has the same key on the first page and after a patch](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-091.md) — When a block holds a link, the page SHALL give it the same key on the first load and after a patch, including a link title that the host wrote itself.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-093 — A document loaded from a patched record gets a fresh nonce](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-093.md) — When the host loads the record of a patched page as a new document, the extension SHALL replace the nonce of the record by a fresh one first.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-094 — Blocks changed by another tool glow briefly](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-094.md) — When the text of a previewed document changes by an undo, a redo or an edit that is neither the preview's own nor typing in the active text editor, the extension SHALL make the blocks the change updated glow once for about 600 ms, with the text readable and nothing moved.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-097 — Two settings decide how the panes follow each other](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-097.md) — When the text editor is scrolled or a block of the preview is scrolled to or clicked, the extension SHALL move the other pane only as far as markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.scrollPreviewWithEditor (boolean, on by default) and markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.scrollEditorWithPreview (boolean, on by default) allow.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-100 — Scrolling the text editor scrolls the preview to the same line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-100.md) — When the text editor of a previewed document scrolls while the anchor mode is on, the extension SHALL record the editor's first visible line as the anchor of each preview of that document, owned by the editor, and scroll the preview so that this line sits at its reading line, without reporting that scroll back to the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-108 — Scrolling or clicking the preview reveals the source line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-108.md) — When the reader scrolls the preview to another source line or activates a rendered block outside edit mode, the extension SHALL reveal that source line in the visible text editor that shows the preview's file, as the settings allow, and leave every editor unmoved when no visible text editor shows that file or the report names another file.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-112 — A double click reveals the source line only when the double-click setting is on](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-112.md) — When the reader double-clicks a rendered block that is not a link outside edit mode and doubleClickToSwitchToEditor is on, the extension SHALL reveal the source line of that block in the text editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-116 — A scroll or reveal report that does not name the current render moves nothing](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-116.md) — When a previewScroll or previewReveal does not name the document, the revision and the request of the render the host holds, the extension SHALL NOT move the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-117 — The page ignores a source scroll for another render](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-117.md) — When the page receives a sourceScroll that names another document, revision or request than its own, the page SHALL ignore it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-119 — Both panes share one reading anchor that survives updates](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-119.md) — When a preview is scrolled, rebuilt, re-laid out or edited, the extension SHALL define its scroll anchor as a source line (the editor's first visible line, and the preview's line at its reading line below the sticky heading band, with the very top of the page always being line 1) and keep that anchor through the update.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-125 — The reading state of recent documents is saved within bounds](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-125.md) — When the page reports its reading state while the reader scrolls, the extension SHALL write the state and post previewState at most once per 100 ms with the last state always reaching the host, record each valid report for the preview's document, and remember the reading state of at most the 200 most recent documents.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-127 — A restored panel reopens its document or explains why it cannot](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-127.md) — When VS Code restores a Studio preview panel, the extension SHALL open in it the Markdown file its saved state names, with the saved reading position, open sections and Description column state, or show the status Preview source missing with the reason the panel cannot be restored.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-136 — A saved state keeps at most 100 open-section indexes between 0 and 9999](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-136.md) — When the extension reads a saved panel state, it SHALL keep at most 100 open-section indexes, each an integer from 0 to 9999, and drop the others.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-137 — A saved state keeps a focused block id of at most 200 characters, a selection of at most 4096 and a boolean Description state](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-137.md) — When the extension reads a saved panel state, it SHALL keep the focused block id up to 200 characters, the selected text up to 4096 characters and descriptionsCollapsed only as a boolean, and drop any other value.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-143 — Closing a preview or folder leaves nothing behind](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-143.md) — When a preview panel is closed, a document is closed, a workspace folder is removed or the extension is deactivated, the extension SHALL cancel the render queue and dispose the pending render stages, file watchers, subscriptions and Problems entries of the preview concerned, so that no late result reaches the panel, keeping every shared resource that another live preview still uses.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-149 — The Studio runs beside the built-in Markdown preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-149.md) — While the Studio runs, the extension SHALL open its side preview beside an open built-in Markdown preview and leave that preview, its commands, the native text diff and every markdown.preview setting and style setting of the built-in Markdown preview as they were.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-151 — A side preview locks its editor group](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-151.md) — When a new side preview opens in an editor group that holds only that panel, the extension SHALL lock the group and, when that locked preview is closed, unlock the group it left empty, one tick later, only if no live preview occupies it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-156 — The settings editor lists the Studio settings in titled groups](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-156.md) — The extension SHALL contribute exactly the settings of its settings registry, with their schema text and defaults generated into package.json, in the groups Preview, Editing, Frontmatter, Comments and PlantUML in that order, each setting with a unique order and a markdownDescription of at most 700 characters, reading a setting with nothing stored, and an absent or wrongly typed boot entry of the page, as its default.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-169 — A view choice made on the page is stored for the workspace](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-169.md) — When the writer changes a view choice on the page, the extension SHALL keep it in the saved state of the panel, post it to the host with the identity of the page, and let the host validate it and store it for the workspace according to the table of view choices.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-170 — A new page starts each view choice from the panel, stored or default value](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-170.md) — When a page opens, the extension SHALL start each view choice from the saved panel state, else the stored workspace value, else the default of that choice, except the theme mode, which starts from the stored workspace value before the saved panel state.
